operators.name: custom_neg

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference step_001 input, i.e. [128, 64, 15360]

semantics: Performs element-wise negation: y = -x for all elements.
Preserves shape, dtype, device, and memory layout (contiguous output).
No broadcasting, reduction, or special boundary handling beyond elementwise.

operators.name: custom_adaptive_avg_pool1d
semantics: Implements AdaptiveAvgPool1d with output size = output_size.
For input time_steps T and output size O, kernel size = ceil(T/O), stride = floor(T/O), with exact same boundaries as PyTorch adaptive avg pooling (start = floor(i*T/O), end = ceil((i+1)*T/O)).
Averages over each window along the last dimension for every batch and channel independently.
Preserves batch and channel dimensions; output shape [B, C, O].
Supports non-contiguous inputs as needed; output contiguous.

operators.name: custom_addcmul_tt
semantics: Computes torch.addcmul(bias, t1, t2) = bias + t1 * t2 with broadcasting of bias over the last dimension (channels).
For each batch b and channel c, output[b,c,:] = bias[c] + t1[b,c,:] * t2[b,c,:].
Supports arbitrary t1/t2 strides; bias must be contiguous of length C.
Output shape same as t1/t2, dtype float32, contiguous.
Element-wise negation of input tensor x.
Adaptive average pooling along last dimension from 15360 to 16.
bias + x*x with broadcasting of bias shape [16] over last dimension.
Final tensor after addcmul, shape [128, 64, 16], dtype float32, device CUDA.
